text_block_list.text:
One day, after reaching a milestone in 
those intensive three years spent with 
Gentildonna...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Phew!!
(CRAAAASH!!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...?! Gentil-san... Is she using a 
barbell... as a dumbbell...?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...It's gotten a bit lighter, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, those weights she's loading... 
aren't those the ones specially ordered 
for *that* person?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A & B
text_block_list.text: Eep. L-Let's go...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh. And I was only looking.

Gentildonna, commanding the room with her 
sheer strength... Perhaps with each result 
she achieves, the awe she inspires only 
deepens.

“Still, some things have changed. And that 
is—”

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer.
choice_data_list: The extras are stacked over there.
The extras are stacked over there.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
When it reaches this level, it must have 
been quite difficult to find what you were 
looking for even abroad.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you have to go through a lot of 
trouble to find it?
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's why I had it custom-made.
Yeah, that's why I had it custom-made.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hohoho. Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case, please contact the 
factory in advance. —And tell them things 
are about to get busy.
choice_data_list:
I hope it doesn't end up being an 
anticlimax.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Such words.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Surely you know full well what I am 
destined to achieve.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right. I have a family gathering after 
this, though.
choice_data_list: I take it I'm joining too, understood.

I take it I'll be joining as well. 
Understood.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Giggle.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You make it sound like I'm some kind of 
chatterbox.

With training finished, I attended a party 
hosted by Gentildonna's relatives 
alongside her.

text_block_list.name: Participant A
text_block_list.text: Good day, Trainer-san.

At first, the nerves were stronger... but 
as I gained more experience and 
confidence, I got used to being in front 
of crowds.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Sorry to keep you waiting.

Until a moment ago, Gentildonna had been 
wearing a party dress. She was greeting 
people in that outfit, but...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm heading home now.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
My muscles are in great condition today. I 
haven't trained nearly enough yet.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If there's an open spot on the uphill 
track, I'd like to use it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Now then... Were you able to foresee this 
outcome as well?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... It is a relief to see there is 
still room for growth.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Continue to think carefully and take on 
challenges boldness. As my Trainer, that 
is."
